message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) contains roughly **95 kcal**.  
In general, raw apples have about **52 kcal per 100 g**, so you can estimate:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~150 | ~78 kcal |
| Medium | ~182 | ~95 kcal |
| Large | ~223 | ~116 kcal |

The exact number varies with variety, ripeness, and whether you eat the skin, but 90–100 kcal is a good rule of thumb for a typical medium apple.
